name: 7900 Fannin St (medical office building), ground-floor lobby
scope: Ground-floor lobby only: the north-south main lobby from the north motor-court entrance to the south plaza doors, the elevator lobby in the middle, and about 10 m of the east-west cross corridor. Floors 2 to 4, the two wing corridors past the ends of the cross corridor, the stairwells, the service elevator and all tenant suites are not scanned. Routes end at the ground-floor passenger elevators. No stair door is visible in the scanned area; EXIT signs can be seen at the far ends of both wing corridors.
